title: High energy density and micrometer-sized d0-free disordered rocksalt cathodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01564B, Paper
Vincent C. Wu, Erick A. Lawrence, Tianyu Li, Euan N. Bassey, Chia-Yu Chang, Bing Joe Hwang, Pierre-Etienne Cabelguen, Raphaële J. Clément
This work showcases a non-equilibrium solid-state synthesis method enabling d0-free disordered rocksalt oxides with the potential to transform the lithium-ion battery cathode landscape.
